hypothesis: The versioned producer and consumer can round-trip one real gated Qwen full-attention block as split-default and fused-uniform payloads with exact identity, logits, graph, and route evidence.
falsifier: Producer metadata, payload exclusivity, gated Q/G width, consumer loading, reconstruction/logits, graph capture, or startup fails.

decision_rules.accept: Both source identities and all real producer-consumer pilot gates pass.
decision_rules.reject: Any schema, width, payload, numerical, graph, route, or health gate fails.
decision_rules.futility: Stop fused topology if it cannot beat split launch cost after correctness.
decision_rules.abort: Abort on OOM, engine death, source drift, or unmeasured fallback.
